Commentary.Commentary: Coming to England's innings, it was looking in tatters when Joe Root was caught and bowled with the score reading 39-4. But then, an 89-run stand between Ben Stokes and Jos Buttler rescued them and put them ahead again, with the latter going on to score 64. The tail wagged around and frustrated the Lankans for a long time. The visitors should be happy and confident of completing the whitewash. Will that happen or will we see the Lankans spring in a surprise?

So the third innings ends and Sri Lanka need 327 to win. It is going to be really tough in the fourth innings. There are 20 overs left in the day. England will come hard at the hosts with the trio of spin bowlers they have. Add to it a few overs of Stuart Broad with the new cherry and the Sri Lankan openers have their work cut out.

OUT! Finally, the England innings comes to an end. Dilruwan Perera gets his 5th wicket. The eighth time he has achieved the feat in Test matches. Also his 100th wicket in home Tests. Flatter ball around off, Leach goes back to play it with a straight bat but gets an outside edge back to the keeper. Dickwella takes a good catch. SO, ENGLAND are ALL OUT FOR 230.
Flatter ball at the pads, Foakes flicks it to mid-wicket and picks up a single. Perera can have two gos at Foakes.
Another couple, Foakes comes down the wicket and hits it wide of mid on. The fielder has to slide to stop the ball and there is an easy two here.
Looped up outside off, Foakes comes down the wicket and defends to mid-wicket.
Flatter ball on middle, Foakes pushes it in the gap through the covers and comes back for two. Good running sensing the opportunity to get two there.
Flighted and at the pads, Leach defends it into the ground easily.
Short and wide down leg side, Ben rocks back and pulls it away to deep fine leg for a single.
In the air but safe! Another sweep, another top edge but well away from deep fine leg. The batsmen pick up two in the meantime.
Another sweep and this goes straight to the fielder at square leg.
Slight halt in the play as Kusal Mendis needs some medical attention. The physios and the magic spray is out. We are good to go.
OUCH! This must have hurt. Foakes sweeps this one aimed at the pads, coming half ahead and right into the shoulder of Kusal Mendis at short leg. He seems to be in some pain.
Down the leg side and turning into the pads, Foakes sweeps it down to short fine leg.
This is shorter and Leach pushes it to backward point off the back foot.
Leach plays this off the front foot and towards point.
Flatter delivery outside off, Foakes plays it late to deep backward point for a single. Two balls for Leach to handle.
Foakes punches this ball off his back foot and declines the single.
Full and at the pads, Foakes plays it to mid-wicket for no run.

NOT OUT! You have to be kidding me! The Ball Tracker shows that the ball would have missed leg stump. Good review from England, done actually as it was the last wicket anyway. But Lo and behold! The ball which was on middle goes on to miss leg stump according to the Ball Tracker. Sri Lanka face more frustration.
Foakes has been given out LBW! He goes upstairs immediately.
This one is at the pads, Leach stays back and defends it into the ground on the leg side.
Foakes gets a single to deep cover. Leach has to play a ball.
Flatter delivery on the pads, Ben flicks it to square leg.
Full and on middle, Foakes plays it straight down to the bowler who dives to his left and stops the ball.
Pulled away to deep square leg but no run taken.
Over the wicket, the ball beats the outside edge of Foakes as he tries to defend it. The ball seemed to have taken off the rough.
Woakes retains strike as he pushes it to mid on and gets a single. Lead is 316.
Flighted at the pads, Foakes pushes it to short mid-wicket.
Flatter ball at the pads, worked away to square leg.
Misses his sweep completely and the ball misses the off pole by a whisker. England's last wicket seems to be a very stubborn one.
The ball is full and Foakes defends off the front foot with a straight bat.
Driven hard to long on by Foakes, but no run taken.
Wide down the leg side, the batsman leaves it alone.
This one is flatter on the pads, Leach misses the ball as he tries to flick it and gets hit on the pad, outside the line of the stumps.
Leach gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.

NOT OUT! The decision has to be overturned. The ball was on middle and Leach comes down the wicket and the ball lobs off his pad and the keeper takes it. Sri Lanka appeal and the umpire gives it out. Leach reviews immediately and the replays show that the ball was nowhere near his bat. England go on.
Leach has been given caught behind. He goes upstairs straight away.
The ball is flatter, Leach stays back and defends this one off the back foot.
Flighted and outside off, Leach comes ahead to defend.

NOT OUT! The ball is clipping the stumps and the umpire's decision will remain. Sri Lanka don't lose their review. The ball was quicker and on middle. It turns a little and beats Foakes as he tries to sweep. Gets hit on the pad and Sri Lanka decide to review as they have 2 reviews left. The England innings will go on at least for another ball.
Sri Lanka have taken a review for an LBW decision given against them.
Drops this one outside off, Foakes plays it late and towards third man. Picks up a couple.
Similarly defended after coming down the wicket.
Foakes comes down the wicket and dead bats it.
The batsman has driven this full one outside off to mid off.
Flatter ball at the pads, flicked toward mid-wicket but Foakes doesn't take the run.
Full and on middle, defended off the front foot.

DROPPED at short leg! The ball was looped up on middle and Leach gets an inside edge on his bid to defend, that is just a little too far away from the diving short leg fielder. Very difficult chance as the replays suggest later.
Jack Leach is the last man in.

OUT! One to go now. Muted celebrations among the Lankans. Comes around the wicket, Broad plays ahead to this one and gets an inside edge that goes into the waiting arms of Kusal Mendis at short leg. This match has been about close-in catching. England are 313 ahead now.
Third ball in the row on off and kept away on the front foot by Broad.
A replica of what happened on the previous ball.
Flighted outside off, Broad comes ahead and defends it easily.
Flatter ball on middle, Foakes stays deep in his crease and keeps this out.
Flighted on middle, defended showing the full face of the bat.
Flatter ball on the middle, Foakes defends off the back foot.
Full and at the pads, Foakes works it down the leg side to square leg.
Flatter delivery on the pads, Broad gets off the mark with a single to mid-wicket.
Flighted on off, Foakes pushes it to long on and gets the new man on strike.
Stuart Broad is in at no. 10.

OUT! The on field decision will have to be overturned. Finally a good review for Sri Lanka. The ball was outside leg and turns away from Rashid who cleared his front leg and comes ahead to defend. The ball bounces more and grazes his glove on the way to the keeper. It is a smart catch from Dickwella. Eighth one down for England. They are now effectively 311-8. The funny part in this review was that Dickwella didn't look like he had much of a say. The slip fielder told Lakmal to take it upstairs.
Sri Lanka appeal for a caught behind. Umpire shakes his head. They go up for a review.
Flighted at the pads, Foakes tucks it behind square on the leg side for another run.
Flatter ball at the middle stump, Foakes stays back in the crease and defends it.
Down the leg side, Foakes works it to square leg. No run.
Flighted on middle, pushed to short cover.
Over the wicket and full at the pads, worked to mid-wicket for a single.
Malinda Pushpakumara to bowl from the other end.
Whipped away to square leg by Adil Rashid to deep square leg. Single taken and the lead is now 309.
Looped up on middle, defended with soft hands by Adil.
Flighted outside off, played down the ground to long on for a single.
Looped up on middle, Rashid drops it on the leg side and gets a single. The fielder at mid-wicket is lazy and allows for the single.
Flighted outside off, Rashid is half ahead to defend it.
Looped up on off, Adil dead bats it.
The players are out in the middle for the final session of play. Dilruwan Perera to start off proceedings, and Adil Rashid to face.
... Day 3, Session 3 ...

A slow, dull session. Shared, one would presume. But England do seem to have their noses ahead as the lead has moved over 300. Sri Lanka let singles be taken very easily in this session and England, despite losing three wickets in this session won't be too worried. A little bit of resurrection for the chinaman, Sandakan though. He picked up two wickets and kept his feet behind the line. On the other hand, Moeen had another failure with the bat and its started to look like he is in the side more as a spinner. Nevertheless, Sri Lanka look like they are going through the motions and seem to be waiting for England to make a mistake now. The last two days, most wickets have fallen in the final session. Will it be the case today ? Join us in a bit for the 3rd session.
Swept behind square to pick up two runs. That will be Tea on Day 3.
Gets to the pitch of the ball and gives it to the short mid-wicket fielder.
Loopy ball on middle and leg, turned to the on side.
Another similar ball around off, driven past the bowler for a single.
Full again down the leg side, flicked away to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Full on leg, swept fine to short fine leg for a single.
AR has played that off the front foot and into the ground. Another over before Tea.
Outside off, cut late towards backward point for a single. The 300-run lead is up for England. Still going strong.
Fuller ball around off, driven to covers for a run.
On off, Rashid pushes it to the off side.
Better length, Rashid comes forward and bunts this.
Arm ball on middle, a touch short. Adil is happy to defend this.
Down the leg side, helped to fine leg. They take one.
On middle and legs, played with a straight bat.
On middle and leg, Rashid gets it off the inner half towards square leg.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Foakes rocks back and works this ball towards square leg for a run.
Fuller ball on off, another soft leading edge past the bowler towards mid off to bring up the 200 for the visitors.
On middle and leg, driven to mid on.
On middle and off, defended off the front foot.
Outside off, a soft leading edge towards the slip fielder.
Short ball on off, Rashid turns it away to cow corner to give Foakes the strike.
Around off, played back to the bowler.
Outside off, cut to covers.
Malinda Pushpakumara is called into the attack. Just the five overs for him so far.
Around off, played to the off side.
Full again on middle and leg, milked past mid on for an easy run.
FOUR! SHOT! Elegance. Full, almost a half volley around off, Rashid creams it through covers for a great boundary.
Played through mid-wicket by BF. They pick up a single.

FOUR! A boundary after a long time. A bit short outside off, Foakes rocks back and cuts it through cover-point. No protection there and the ball races away. Just the 10th boundary of the innings. No sixes yet.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and on middle, Rashid can't get his flick past short mid-wicket.
Full and on off, dug out well by Rashid.
Loopy ball on middle and leg. Stonewalled.
Full and on middle, hit to long on to give his partner the strike.
Arm ball on the pads, helped towards short fine leg for a run.
On off, taped in front of him.
The ball takes the outside edge and runs toward backward point as Rashid tries to whip this flatter ball towards square leg. Picks up a single and keeps the strike.
Fuller on middle, Rashid covers the spin and defends it back to Sandakan.
Fuller and on the pads, Foakes flicks it away on the front foot this time for a single to deep square leg.
Shorter ball landing on middle. The ball turns and hits Foakes on his thigh pad as he looks to flick it away.
Short and outside off, Rashid cuts it away behind point for a single.
Flighted on middle, Rashid is on the back foot. He punches it straight to cover.
Rashid goes for a slog but can only get a single down to long on. The ball was in the air but not near any fielder.
Shorter ball outside leg, keeps low and hits Rashid on the pad. But the ball is way down leg for LBW.
Flatter ball on middle, Adil comes ahead and defends it back to the bowler.
Flighted this time, the keeper comes down the wicket and plays it to long on for a single.
Flatter ball outside off, Foakes is back in his crease as he defends it.
Flatter delovery on middle, turns after landing and the keeper collects it down the leg side.
On the pads, worked away towards square leg. Ben will retain the strike for the next over.
Pushed to the cover region by BF.
Wrong 'un. Foakes plays it away from his body and gets beaten.
On middle and leg, hit to mid-wicket.
This one is down the leg side and the batsman leaves it alone.
Outside off, Rashid punches it away from mid off for a run.
Ben shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Down the leg side. Turned away towards square leg. They cross.
Foakes uses his feet again, Foakes turns it to cow corner. One more run added.
Flicks this through mid-wicket and changes ends.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Sweeps this from outside off, Foakes sweeps it to deep square leg for a brace.
Down the leg side, helped to short fine leg for one.
Around middle and leg, played to short leg.
Second time now Foakes has hit the ball in the air. Gets on one knee to swipe it but gets a top edge towards square leg. They cross.
Full in line, flicked uppishly over mid-wicket for a single.
Leg spinner on middle and off, Rashid gets low and plays it onto the ground.
Covers his stumps and blocks this one out.
Full and on middle and leg, Foakes hits it towards mid on.
On the pads, flicked off the pads.
Similar line, Foakes flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Down leg again, Foakes works it to the on side.
Arm ball around off, turned to the leg side.
Rashid stays inside his crease and bunts this one down.
Gets behind the ball and stonewalls this.
Played to mid-wicket region by Adil.
Leg spinner on off, Rashid reads it well and sees it out.
Adil Rashid is the next batsman.

OUT! Excellent catch! Another one for Sandakan after the break and no overstepping again. Leg spinner outside off, Moeen tries to cut it late but Dhananjaya at first slip dives to his left. Goes in with soft hands to the ball which enables it to stick. The lead is worth 267 now.
Leg spinner outside off, Ali pokes at it but misses.
Around off, Foakes keeps this out.
Outside off, Moeen drives it away from cover-point to change strike.
Pushed to the cover region by Buttler. They pick up a single.
Inside edge. Some turn for Perera. Foakes tries to block this with a straight bat but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Full on middle and leg, Foakes dances down but blocks it.
Arm ball outside off, Foakes gets to the ball but fails to block it. Impact way outside of that.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Outside off, left alone.
Pushed to the cover region by Ali.
Foakes plays a pull shot to this short delivery. The batsmen have run through for a single. Ben is off the mark.
Loopy ball on off, Foakes gets one off the middle of the bat.
Ben Foakes in the next batsman in.

OUT! Brilliant bowling by Sandakan and finally a wicket for him. Sees Buttler charging down the wicket so darts this way down leg. Buttler who comes using his feet so well finally misses one this time. That spun enough for Jos who tried adjusting to it. Dickwella moves to his left and collects it well. Takes off the bails and Buttler who tries to come back knows he is short of the crease. Sri Lanka need to capitalize on this now.
Buttler has been stumped down the leg side here. The leg umpire goes upstairs for the decision. Looked out to the naked eye.
Short ball outside off, Ali is happy to block it.
Straighter one on off, cut to point.
Similar length, closer to the off pole, hit off the back foot.
A bit flat outside off, punched back to the bowler.
Around off, kept out.
Full and on off, driven to covers.

Time for a Drinks break. And time for Lakmal to think about what to be done next. Its been all too easy for England. They have milked around the bowlers at will and picked up singles easily. No risk at all and the bowlers have looked ineffective. Buttler especially running down the wicket to almost every ball is making batting look so easy. The hosts need to do something quick, they are getting pushed out of the game.
Wrong 'un, Jos is down the wicket and defends it to the bowler.
Full toss outside off, Ali drives it to long off and gets to the other end.
Flighted outside off, Ali defends it on the front foot.
Outside leg and full, Buttler works it away to deep backward square leg for a single.
Crashed away on the off side to sweeper cover for another single. England doing it easily here.
So full and Jos plays it to long on easily for a run.
Ali prods ahead and dead bats this full one.
Flighted ball on middle, Buttler comes down the wicket and gathers a run to deep mid-wicket.
Jos is down the ground and defends it to mid-wicket.
Flatter ball on middle, Ali is on the backfoot and defends to mid on and gets a run.
Delivered wide outside off seeing the batsman come down, but Jos reaches out and hits it to long off for one.
Flatter ball on off, Ali drops it down on the off side and takes a quick single. Jos is lightning quick to respond too.
Moeen keeps strike as he cuts this away and picks up a single.
Flighted outside off, left alone by Ali as the ball turns away.
A carbon copy of the previous delivery.
Flighted outside off, Ali comes ahead and defends.
Full toss on middle, Jos paddles it away to deep fine leg for another run.
Flatter ball that lands on leg stump, Ali stands tall and pushes it to long on for a single.
Full ball on middle, Buttler plays it away but straight to mid-wicket.
Jos is down the wicket again and pads this one away.
Flighted and at the pads, Buttler defends it to short leg.
Similar delivery, Ali finds the gap towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Loopy on the pads, Ali dead bats it.
Flatter ball at the pads, worked away to deep square leg for yet another single. All too easy for Jos.
Very full and Ali misses the attempted drive. Dickwella gets hit on the left pad.
Flighted outside off, wrong 'un. Jos reads it well and works it mid off for a single.
Short outside off, Ali cuts it to sweeper for a run. The lead is now 250.
Looped up, Jos comes down and takes it on the full. Pulls it away to deep square leg for one. Feels he missed out there.
Flatter ball that turns in after landing, Buttler adjust well and defends to mid-wicket.
Flighted outside off, Jos comes down yet again to defend it.
Lakshan Sandakan back on now.
Beautifully bowled, beats Jos in the flight but he adjusts well in the end to work it away on the leg side behind square for a run.
Fully flighted, Mo sweeps it away to fine leg for another run.
Looped up on middle, Ali prods ahead and defends it back to the bowler.
Down the leg side, Ali looks to guide it but doesn't get any bat on it. Dickwella stops it with his pads.
This one is flatter on off, Ali pushes it to backward point.
Looped up outside off, Jos has his dancing shoes on again and pushes it away to cover for a single. 150 up for the visitors.
Comes ahead and bunts down this one.
Looped up on off, Ali comes ahead and defends it.
Flatter ball and keeps going with the angle, Buttler pushes it through the covers wide of mid off for a single.
Flighted and almost yorker length, Ali plays it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on off, Mo comes ahead and defends it.
Ali has punched that ball through the offside but straight to cover.
Reverse swept away to third man, the batsmen come back for two.

Looped up on off, Buttler comes down the wicket and gets a thick outside edge to third man for a couple. Gets to his 12th Test fifty. No massive celebrations. Its been a great innings though. Looking positive from the outset.
Moeen pushes this flatter one to the cover region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Ali failed to make contact and was hit low on the pads. A strong appeal from the bowler and fielders. The umpire decides the batsman is not out. The bowler doesn't seem interested to go upstairs.
FOUR! This is a really quick outfield. The full ball outside off takes the thick outside edge as Ali comes ahead to defend. It goes wide of slip and beats backward point to the fence.
Flatter ball on off stump, Moeen is back in his crease and plays it back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, driven to sweeper and strike retained.
Flatter ball on middle, Ali defends it back to de Silva.
Outside off and turning away, left alone.
Full on middle, Buttler works it away to mid-wicket for a run. Gets to 49.
Flatter delivery on off, Ali plays it away stylishly to deep mid-wicket but just for a single.
Flighted on off, Moeen Ali defends it on the front foot.
Good ball to end the over, outside off and quicker. Grips and turns to get the inside edge of Jos. But the ball just rolls along the ground onto the leg side.
Shorter length and outside off, Moeen pushes it to sweeper for a run.
Flatter delivery at the pads, Ali dead bats it to short leg.
Loopy delivery on off, Buttler comes down again and pushes it towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Shorter outside off, Ali cuts it away for another run to sweeper.
Looped up on off, Ali plays it with soft hands to backward point.
Fuller ball outside off, Ali drives to sweeper cover to keep strike.
Flatter ball outside off, Moeen pushes it through the cover. The fielder dives and prevents the single.
Flatter outside off, Buttler late cuts it away to deep point for another run.
The ball was flighted outside off, Moeen taps it down toward third man for a single.
This one is at the pads, Buttler flicks it away for a single to square leg.
Flatter ball on middle, Jos defends off the back foot.
Flatter ball outside off, left alone.
Moeen Ali is the new man in.

OUT! No third time lucky for Stokes! And guess what? Dilruwan has his leg well inside the popping crease on this occasion. The ball was looped up outside off, Stokes comes charging down and wants to go for a maximum over mid on but his connection is poor and the ball goes towards long on. Pushpakumara there dives forward and takes a good low catch. Stokes knew it straight away that he wasn't clearing the fielder. And must be disappointed considering that is an unwanted shot at that stage after getting a four off the previous one. England are now effectively 224-5.
FOUR! Stokes goes down on one knee to the ball which was flatter and outside off has been smashed away over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Flighted outside off, Buttler comes down again and the turn on the ball beats him as he gets hit on the pad. The ball rolls onto the off side as the batsmen cross over for a leg bye.
Looped up on middle, Jos comes down the wicket and defends it.
Flatter and shorter outside off, Stokes cuts it to sweeper cover for a run.
This ball is shorter and outside off, Stokes pushes the ball to cover point and retains strike for the next over.
Full and outside off, the ball is driven to long off as Jos gets off strike.
Buttler comes down the wicket and gets hit on the pads as he misses his drive.
This one is a straighter one, Stokes flicks it away to square leg for a single.
Flatter delivery on off, Stokes stands tall and punches it straight back.
Reverse sweeps this full one outside off, away for two runs. The backward point fielder makes a half stop and the ball is slowed down for sweeper cover to come around and limit it to two.
Flatter delivery outside off and coming in, Buttler pushes the ball back to the bowler.
Top edge but safe! Jos goes for the sweep but there is no short fine leg so the ball falls in no man's land and the batsment come back for two.
Flatter ball on off, Stokes has driven this to long off for a run.
Flatter ball outside off, Stokes is half forward and dead bats it.
Looped outside off, Jos comes down the wicket, takes it on the full and pushes it to long on for a single.
Looped outside off, swept away to deep square leg and the batsmen come back for two. Great running in such heat!
Dilruwan Perera to bowl from the other end.
Short and on off, Stokes defends it towards cover.
This ball is flatter and on the pads, Buttler flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
This one grips and turns after landing on middle. Hits Buttler on the pads and lobs up toward the leg side.
Flatter delivery on middle, Jos stands tall and defends it back to the bowler.
Fuller and on middle, Buttler is half forward in defense.
DROPPED! Down the leg side, Jos gets a tickle on this one and Dickwella down the leg side cannot hold onto it. Buttler now dropped on 38.
We are back for the second session. The players are making their way out to the middle. Jos Buttler to face the first ball from Dhananjaya de Silva.
... Day 3, Session 2 ...

So what began in such a good way for Sri Lanka, has ended demoralizingly. They, though can't afford to be sulking about it and will need to come rejuvenated after the break. Or else, England could just be out of sight. Do join us for the post Lunch session.

This session began with a bang for Sri Lanka, with a wicket of the first ball. Three more wickets followed over the next hour. But the second hour has seen Jos Buttler and Ben Stokes just take control of the situation and pull England out of the slight trouble they were in. They have played beautifully after the Drinks break and at the same time, got runs at a good pace. The lead has swelled upto 206 runs. And during this partnership, Buttler has been given out once but reviewed to survive. Stokes was dismissed twice but on both occasions, Sandakan had overstepped. These errors might just prove to be too costly later. England should have been at least 6 wickets down, if not more. Dilruwan Perera and Malinda Pushpakumara bowled beautifully. Sandakan has been expensive.
Rocks back and punches this ball to the off side. That will be LUNCH on Day 3.
Gets to the pitch of this one and blocks it out.

NO BALL! What is Sandakan doing? This is the second time he is overstepping. SECOND TIME, for a spinner. Not helping their cause. Gives this air on off, Stokes goes fishing but gets an outside edge at first slip. Dhananjaya takes the catch but the umpires have asked the batsman to wait. Only to find out that there is nothing behind the line. 2 gone, 7 more lives left for Stokes.
Stokes goes to pull one but misses to get hit on the pads.
Leg spinner on middle, pushed towards covers for another run.
Down the leg, swept through deep square leg to rotate strike.
Full and on off, driven past the cover fielder to get off strike.
Prods forward and keeps another one out.
Leans ahead and blocks this one out.
Brilliant running. The moment Stokes nudged that on the leg side he wanted two. Plays this with soft hands towards cow corner and comes back for the second.
On middle and leg, Buttler rocks back and works it towards square leg to bring up the 200-run lead.
Flatter on middle, taped in front of him.
On middle and leg, turned to the leg side.
Buttler has swept that one through the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single. Sandakan figures after 4 overs read, 4-0-32-0. 8 rpo.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Gets behind this ball and keeps this one out.
FOUR! Errs down the leg side, Stokes goes back and flicks it through square leg for another boundary. The 100 is up for England.
Down the leg side, Stokes leaves it alone. The ball rolls to the fine leg region. They cross but the umpire signals a dead-ball as there was no intention of a shot.
Low full toss outside off, Buttler sweeps it towards square leg for a run.
Jos flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On middle and leg, Buttler makes room and looks to flick it but gets a leading edge over the bowler's head for a couple of runs.
Flighted ball on off, driven through covers for a single.
Around off, Stokes plays it to the off side.
Ben has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On off, bunted down.
This is the wrong 'un but the ball is way outside off. Left alone pretty easily.
Flighted outside off, Buttler is down the wicket and keeps it out by hitting it straight to mid off.
Short of a length on middle, Stokes punches it away off the backfoot to cover for a run.

NOT OUT! Stokes gets a life. Sandakan has overstepped. The ball was outside off and Stokes lobbed his drive up straight to cover. The celebration of Sri Lanka is short lived though, as the umpires ask Stokes to wait and check for the No ball. And to the dismay of the Lankans, the chinaman has overstepped.
Floated up and a full toss on middle, Buttler paddles it to fine leg for a single.
Short length, Stokes pulls it away off the bottom of his bat to deep mid-wicket. The single brings up the 50-run partnership between these two.
Flighted on off, Buttler is down the wicket and drives to long off for a single.
Flatter ball on off stump, Stokes is half ahead as he defends the ball.
Flatter and quicker on off, Stokes defends it to cover.
Looped up on middle, defended off the front foot by Stokes.
Looped up and at the pads, worked behind square leg for a single.

NOT OUT! Buttler survives. The bounce saves him. Loopy ball on middle, Jos comes charging but misses his shot. Gets rapped in front of the stumps on his knee roll. The players put in an appeal and the umpire gives it out. After a chat with his partner Jos takes it up. Replay shows us that the ball would have gone over the stumps. The on-field decision has to be overturned. England retain their review.
REVIEW! The dangerous Buttler is given LBW. He opts for the review.
On leg, turned to mid-wicket to give Buttler the strike.
Dhananjaya de Silva is asked to bowl.
Tossed up outside off, Butter gets to the pitch and punches it to covers. Sensible batting.
FOUR! Excellent batting. The pace of Sandakan is allowing Buttler to catch it on the full. Charges down the track and flicks it fine through mid on this time for back-to-back boundaries.
FOUR! Yet another quick feet powerful flick from Buttler. Takes it on the full and whips this through mid-wicket for a boundary. Takes the lead to 177.
Drags this outside off, Stokes swipes it through mid-wicket for just one.
Around off, Stokes cannot get it past covers.
Leg spinner on middle and leg, blocked out by Stokes.
On middle and leg, Buttler goes back and turns another one fine towards fine leg. Two runs taken.
Leg side again, worked away through square leg for one more.
On the pads, turned away to square leg for a run.
Tossed up on leg, Buttler is froward to pad it out. The ball balloons and there are cries of catch it for Perera who dives ahead but cannot get to the ball.
Around off, driven firmly to extra cover to get to the other end.
Full and on middle, Stokes prods forward and bunts this one down.
Charges down again, flicks it through mid-wicket for a brace. Nice use of the feet.
FOUR! Comes down and takes it on the full. Times is beautifully past the mid off fielder to the fence. Boundary.
Up and over. Reverse sweeps this over the slip fielder. They pick up a single. Its been given as leg byes. The ball seems to have gone off his arm.
Leg spinner pitches and goes past the outside edge of Stokes' bat. Not much you can do with those except not nick that.
FOUR! Very fine. Loopy ball down the leg side. Stokes sweeps it very fine past the keeper. The outfield is quick and the ball races away to the fine leg boundary. Another boundary for Ben Stokes.
Leggie on middle, turned through mid-wicket for one.
Lakshan Sandakan is called onto bowl.
Flatter ball over the stumps, played back to the bowler.
FOUR! SHOT! No one out there except the ball boy. Poor ball from Perera, short and on middle. Stokes goes deep and pulls it over mid-wicket to the boundary fence.
Outside off again, cut past point for a run.
Outside off, cut through mid off. The fielder there manages to get a hand to it and keep it to one.
On middle and leg, Buttler is well ahead to block it out. It hits his pads and rolls towards the off side. They cross. Sri Lanka appeal but Jos was over 3 meters ahead. Leg bye given.
Loopy ball around off, Stokes pushes it through cover-point. He walks and completes the run.
Enough time for Buttler to rock back and drill it through mid-wicket. They manage to come back for the second.
Flatter ball on middle and leg, pushed towards mid on to change ends.
Played to mid-wicket region by Jos. They pick up a single.
Similar line, Buttler stays back and punches it to on side.
Around off, pushed to mid off.
On middle, punched back to the bowler.
Sees Buttler charging down so darts this wide down the leg side. Jos gets bat to it and milks it to cow corner for a run.
Makes Buttler go on his back foot who pushes it ahead.
Stokes rocks back and punches it through covers for a single.
PEACH! Arm ball on a perfect length, Stokes is forward to play at it but it goes past his outside edge.
Full and on middle and off, Stokes hits it towards mid on.
Flatter ball down the leg side, Buttler shuffles across and turns it through mid-wicket for one.
Around off, Buttler paddles it fine towards fine leg. One run taken.
Outside off, cut away late to short third man.
Down leg, worked away to the on side for a single.
Getas behind the ball and stonewalls this one.
Goes back and blocks this one out.
Played to mid-wicket region by Ben Stokes.

First Drinks break of the day! What an opening hour of play we have had. This is what Test cricket is all about. The twists and turns. Sri Lanka had to come out all guns firing and that's exactly what they have done. The pitch is also assisting them but credit must be given to the good lengths they're bowling. But they can't afford to loosen up. England, on the other hand, will be looking for a partnership.
Outside off, Jos goes back and punches it through cover-point for an easy couple to get off the mark.
Loopy ball on middle, Buttler uses his feet and turns it to the on side.
Full and in line of the stumps, Buttler is solid in his defense.
Full on middle and leg, flicked away to cow corner to get off strike.
Outside off, played to gully.
Flatter on middle, Stokes goes back and plays it with a straight bat.
Jos Buttler replaces his skipper in the middle.

OUT! The previous ball drops short but this one carries surely! Another one bites the dust. This time, it's the skipper. A huge wicket for the hosts. The ball is on middle and straightens after landing. Root closes the face of the bat too early and the ball takes the leading edge back to the bowler. Pushpakumara dives to his left and takes a great catch. England seem to be in a hurry here. From being 99-0, they are now effectively 135-4! We seem to be having a game on our hands.

DROPS JUST SHORT! Stokes goes for the sweep but  gets the top edge and the ball goes in the air but falls just short of deep mid-wicket. Angelo Mathews comes running in but can't make it in time. Lots happening here! The batsmen pick up one.
Very full, almost yorker length. Root waits for the ball and pushes it to mid-wicket for a single.
This is flatter and outside off, Stokes plays a push toward point and gets to the other end.
Full and at middle, Stokes flicks it to short mid-wicket.
Flighted on off, defended on the front foot back to the bowler.
Flatter ball on middle, Root is on the back foot and defends it right into the surface.
Stokes is off the mark as he drives this off the front foot to long off.
Full and flighted on middle, Stokes takes a big stride ahead to defend the ball.
Ben Stokes walks out to bat.

OUT! Dilruwan gets his third! Shorter and on middle, Bairstow looks to flick it away but finds short leg. Kaushal Silva, the substitute fielder takes a smart catch. Jonny who got a beautiful hundred in the first innings walks out cheaply this time! Sri Lanka slowly but surely clawing their way back in the game. Need to keep up the pressure though. England effectively 131/3.
Too full and played with the turn to long on for another single.
Flighted outside off, Bairstow pushes it on the off side with soft hands and picks up a quick single. Good running.
A single down to long off to end the over. 8 runs off this one.
Full and on middle, Root rotates strike by playing it towards mid-wicket.
Driven straight down the ground to long off for a single.
FOUR! This is such good timing from YJB! The ball is full and on middle, flicked away wide of long on for a four as he comes to the pitch of the ball.
Looped up on middle, Bairstow comes ahead and defends.
Flatter ball at the pads, Root pushes it to mid-wicket and sets off to pick up a couple but slips as he completes his first run.
Malinda Pushpakumara is into the attack.
Full and on middle, Root pushes it to long on and retains strike.
Conventional sweep from Root to deep square leg for another run.
Flatter ball on middle, Root drops it on the off side and picks up a quick single.
Full toss on leg, Jonny reverse sweeps it to deep point for a run.
Flatter ball outside off, Root is off the mark with a single off a late cut to third man.
Joe Root is the new man in.

OUT! Plumb in front and follows suit of his opening partner. The ball is looped up on middle and Burns completely misses his flick to be rapped in front of middle. Looks back at Bairstow, his partner perhaps ask him if there was an inside edge, Rory shakes his head and continues walking. Second wicket for Perera. The umpire checks for the front foot and it is very close but fine.
Good length ball on off stump, Bairstow defends it back to the bowler.
No ball. Overstepping by Lakmal. The ball is short of a length and outside off, Burns defends it on the off side and picks up a quick single.
Slower ball which is taken on the full by Jonny, gets a thick outside edge to deep point for a single.
The drive sounded good off the bat but straight to extra cover.
Wide ball. Bouncer! But was too high above the head of Bairstow and signaled wide.
Overpitched on off stump, JB drives it straight to mid off.
This one is on a good length and wide outside off. Bairstow goes after it but drives straight to cover.
Full length ball outside off, Bairstow drives it to mid off.
This one is overpitched on leg stump, the ball is swept away by Burns to deep fine leg and the batsmen come back for two.
Fuller ball on off stump, Burns comes ahead and defends it.
Flatter ball outside off, defended to point.

Appeal from Perera but the umpire isn't interested. The ball started outside off and spun to hit Jonny on the pads as he misses his sweep. But the bounce was a little too much and the ball might've missed the stumps. The batsmen pick up a leg bye as the ball rolls down towards short fine leg.
What a peach! This one holds its line and completely squares up Jonny who plays for the turn.
Looped up on middle, the ball is pushed to a deepish mid on for a single.
Shorter outside off, pushed off the back foot to short cover.
Well outside off this time, left alone by JB.
Just 8 overs old and the umpires are having a look at the ball. Lakmal doesn't get his wish fulfilled and will have to continue with it.
Beautiful sound off the bat as he drives this fuller one outside off. It goes straight to wide mid off though.
Forward in defense to a fuller one outside off.
Length ball outside off, comes ahead and defensively pushes it to cover.
Good length ball on off, Jonny defends it toward mid on.
This one is on a length and spins a lot more as it goes down the leg side and beats Dickwella and runs down fine on the leg side. The batsmen pick up three byes.
This one is flatter and turns in a bit after landing on middle. Jonny plays it back to the bowler.
Flatter and shorter delivery outside off, cut away to sweeper for a single.
Fuller and on off, Burns comes ahead and defends this one.
Full and at the pads, Jonny works it to square leg for a single.
Short ball outside leg, bounces a bit more and Bairstow pulls out of the shot at the last moment. Dickwella fumbles the collection.
Good length ball just outside off, Burns defends it toward cover.
Slightly shorter and on top of off stump, defended staying back in the crease.
On a length and outside off, left alone again.
Good length and outside off again, Burns chooses to leave it alone.
Short of a length outside off, Burns lets it go through.

Full on off, Jonny goes for the push through the off side. Just gets an edge, which goes between the slips and gully towards the fence. The batsmen pick up three till the ball comes back to the keeper.
Suranga Lakmal to bowl from the other end.
Looped on off stump, Burns comes ahead and defends it straight back.
This one is quicker and at the pads, first run of the day as the ball is flicked away by JB to deep mid-wicket for a single. The lead is now 100.
Full and on middle, defended off the middle of the bat this time.
A push towards short mid-wicket.
Looped on leg stump, Bairstow drops it just short of short leg.
Jonny Bairstow is in at no. 3.

OUT! Gone first ball! Sri Lanka couldn't have asked for a better start. A drifter from Perera and lands on middle. Jennings is ahead to defend and plays down the wrong line. Gets hit on the pad, and the umpire's finger goes up after a bit of thinking. Keaton considers reviewing but in the end, just continues walking. The replays show that the ball was just clipping leg stump and the decision would've stayed if he had reviewed.
The players are walking out into the field. Keaton Jennings will be facing the first ball. It will be bowled by Dilruwan Perera.

Keaton Jennings on an interview now, says that they bowled better after Tea and the wicket is one where it's easier to bat once you are in for some time. States that the pitch is unpredictable, and there is intermittent turn. Says that the key as a bowler is to hit the stumps. Adds that the cracks opened up a lot more than on Day 1 and also that the patches outside the left-hander's off stump is pretty evident. Laughs when asked about him being the permanent short leg for England, says that the key is to anticipate what the batsman wants to do. Moving with the line and length ball is the key. On their plan, he says that they will like to bat the day and extend the lead to as much as possible, and move to an even stronger position.

Sri Lanka on the other hand, would have had a decent night's rest and will like to put the last session of play yesterday behind them, and come roaring out on the field with all their energy. They need to be on the attack and try to win this game by limiting England to a score that they can possibly chase in the fourth innings. The key players today should again be the spinners as the cracks have widened and the pitch has become even drier. Hopefully there won't be any rain. The first ball is not very far away! Join us in a bit.

Good morning! Welcome to Day 3. The game took a massive swing last evening as we saw Sri Lanka losing their way and concede a lead of 96 runs to England in the first innings. Dhananjaya de Silva and Dimuth Karunaratne's huge stand of 142 for the second wicket was nullified by the fact that Sri Lanka lost their last nine wickets for 67 runs. The England openers then came out and saw out the four overs that could be bowled before bad light stopped play. Today should be the match defining day as usually is the case with most Tests. Looking ahead to the days play, the visitors would like to bat as long as they can but also score runs at a good click. The pitch is providing assistance to the spinners but batting isn't looking so difficult if you apply yourself well. In fact, the first two sessions on both days have proved easier for batting than the third session where most wickets have been lost by both the teams.
... Day 3, Session 1 ...

The star of today's play was definitely Rashid, who got his best Test figures of 13.5-2-49-5. Stokes bowled well and was helped by some poor batting by the hosts as well. Earlier on in the day, Dhananjaya de Silva and Dimuth Karunaratne made a massive stand of 142 runs. But that didn't prove to be enough. Moving on though, Sri Lanka have to get some rest and come out fighting as they can't let their shoulders drop. They must fight like Lions and try to make a game out of this dire situation. England have a much easier task, to just play to the merit and the situation and accumulate runs. Lots of time left in the Test and a result looks imminent if the rain stays away. Join us for play on Day 3 at 1000 local (0430 GMT). Adios! Take care.

Well! Well! What looked like being Sri Lanka's day has turned and one would say England will be happier at Stumps, despite Sri Lanka winning the first two sessions comprehensively. But England won the third session so outright that they are the side on top walking off the field at the end of the day. They have things firmly in their grasp now, with a lead of 99. The visitors are essentially 99 for no loss and will look to bat as long as possible tomorrow, give Sri Lanka a target that would be almost impossible to achieve and would still have enough time to bowl the Lankans out.
Yorker length, Burns defends it with the bottom of his bat. Another maiden. Meanwhile the light has deteriorated and has been offered to the batsmen, they are going off! It will be STUMPS on Day 2.
Flatter ball on middle, no spin at all. Burns defends on the front foot.
Shorter ball on middle, Burns decides to keep it out off his back foot.
Flatter ball on middle, Burns rocks back and defends.
Flatter ball at off, Burns is ahead to this one as he keeps it out.
Full and outside off, Burns plays it with soft hands to point.
Dhananjaya de Silva replaces Malinda Pushpakumara.
Flatter ball outside off, let go by the batsman. Maiden over.
Full and at the pads again, Jennings brings his bat in front of his pad and defends.
Full and at the pads, Jennings pushes it to short mid-wicket.
Similar ball and similarly played.
Jennings is half ahead in defense.
Flatter and quicker on middle, Jennings is inside his crease and defends.
Flatter delivery on off, kept out towards cover.
Fuller and on off, Burns comes forward and dead bats it.
Slower and short outside off, Jennings pushes it towards backward point for a run.
Flighted outside off, Jennings prods ahead and defends.
Short and outside off, Burns cuts it away to backward point for a single.
Flatter ball outside off, punched back to the bowler.
Malinda Pushpakumara to share the new ball.
Flatter ball outside off, Jennings drops it toward point.
Flatter delivery on off, Jennings pushes it to cover.
So close! Jennings chooses to leave the arm ball which misses his off pole by a whisker.
Shorter on off, Burns pushes it to sweeper for a single.
Quicker on middle, Burns defends on the front foot.
Looped up on off and turning away, Burns leaves it alone.
